Gradient Physics Press publishes a unified research program exploring the generative foundations of reality, from fundamental physics and cosmology to life, consciousness, and epistemology. Its monograph series develops frequency-based physical frameworks, process ontology, and mechanism-oriented approaches to understanding how matter, forces, observation, complexity, and experience emerge from underlying dynamical structures.

About the Press

A publishing home for the GOCD–EQT research program

Gradient Physics Press publishes book-length work that develops the conceptual, physical, and philosophical architecture of Gradient Physics.

Gradient Physics Press is an independent scholarly publishing imprint established by Kaisheng Li and Longji Li. Its catalog is centered on foundational questions in theoretical physics and philosophy of physics, with particular emphasis on generative ontology, frequency-based physical models, process ontology, observation, cosmology, and mind–matter relations.

The current catalog comprises ten monographs: the foundational volume on Generative Ontology with Closure Dynamics (GOCD) and a nine-volume Energy Quantum Theory (EQT) corpus. Further titles are planned as the research program develops.

International distribution

Titles from Gradient Physics Press are distributed through Ingram and are available through major online booksellers and retail channels across multiple international markets.

GPP 01
Published-edition cover

Generative Ontology and Closure Dynamics: A Background-Free Event Theory

Authors: Kaisheng Li & Longji Li

This book develops a generative ontology of physical existence. Instead of treating the universe as a collection of pre-existing objects evolving within a fixed spacetime background, it proposes a process-based framework in which events become stable realities through closure, freezing, and readout. GOCD establishes the ontological foundation for the broader GOCD–EQT framework by distinguishing the generative layer from the empirical readout layer. It examines the emergence of time, causality, continuity, probability, and physical structures from deeper organizational principles.

ISBN: 9798996139491

The Foundational Volume of Energy Quantum Theory (EQT): Frequency, Mass, Interaction Range, and the Generative Mechanism of Force

Authors: Kaisheng Li & Longji Li

This volume introduces Energy Quantum Theory (EQT) as a frequency-based framework for understanding physical reality. Starting from the Planck relation and the connection between energy and mass, it develops a frequency–density description in which matter, interaction ranges, and forces are interpreted through energy quantum density fields. The book establishes the fundamental postulates of EQT and provides the conceptual basis for subsequent volumes addressing gravity, electromagnetism, dark components, and detection mechanisms.

ISBN: 9798996139415
